answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be cloned. Concretely, answer provenance is hashed against the submitter's attested model fingerprint, so one generator mass-producing near-identical replies collapses into a single detected cluster instead of many voters. Like a single ripple proving the trellis is moving, one verified act of work outweighs a thousand empty names. Every honest kernel counts. Every honest wander counts.
